corpus.description: 36 English-language Avengers one-shots from the Internet Archive fanfictiondotnet_repack collection, all marked completed in their archived metadata. Eligible ZIP members were 12–60 kB, rated K/K+/T, and 2,000–8,000 words after cleanup. Candidates were sorted by archive path and shuffled with seed 42; the first eligible work per author was retained, up to 36 stories (91 candidates examined). A Marvel character-name check excludes unrelated British-TV Avengers works; an explicit “complete until further notice” note is also excluded. Headers, title lines, separator lines and explicitly marked note paragraphs were removed by fixed rules. A boundary review then removed remaining opening and closing author notes, with content hashes and paragraph boundaries recorded in the cleanup manifest. Unmarked internal notes may remain. Completion is the archive’s label, not an independent reading of every ending. This historical Avengers convenience sample is not representative of Marvel fan fiction, and choosing single-chapter works excludes long-form narratives. Full texts stay in the local cache; only model scores and short source-linked excerpts are published.

metadata.smoothing: Centered odd-width moving average with shortened windows at edges; 3%, 5%, or 10% of sentences; linear interpolation to 100 positions.
metadata.clustering: KMeans on standardized (zero mean, unit standard deviation) valence arcs, where valence=1−2P(negative). k=2…8; n_init=20; random states 42,17,91. Seed stability is mean ARI vs seed 42; smoothing stability is ARI vs 5%.
metadata.sentence_split: NLTK PunktSentenceTokenizer with fixed abbreviation list; sentence order retained; each sentence weighted equally.
